name: 11238 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11238 (Brooklyn) has 280 nonprofit organizations. 116 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 85 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11238 (Brooklyn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
